Stories of excellence

An innovative breakthrough for cleaner water

ASU researchers have developed a new technique for removing harmful “forever chemicals” from water, making it safer for people and the environment.

Read more

Thunderbird ranks No. 1 in the world for international trade

For the fifth consecutive year, QS International Trade Rankings has recognized the Thunderbird School of Global Management as the world leader in international trade.

Read more

ASU scientists making progress against Parkinson’s

ASU researchers are making promising advances in early Parkinson’s disease detection, and are finding new ways to slow its progression and treat its symptoms.

Read more

A faster path to graduation and a teaching career

ASU is now offering high-quality three-year bachelor's degrees designed to help future educators graduate sooner and enter the workforce faster.

Read more

Donor support creates more opportunities for ASU students

A record $2 billion endowment is helping ASU create more scholarships, expand experiential learning and prepare students for careers that make an impact.

Read more

Barrett, The Honors College is creating bright futures

Barrett students go on to attend the best graduate schools, win prestigious international fellowships and accept positions with some of the world's top companies.

Read more

The ASU difference:

We are measured not by whom we exclude, but by whom we include and how they succeed

Excerpt from ASU charter

Experience world-class academics

As a comprehensive public research university, ASU is committed to providing excellence in education through the Academic Enterprise, empowering every student and expanding access to higher education for all.

Learn more

Discovery and innovation that serves the public

As ASU focuses on research and discovery of public value, the Knowledge Enterprise advances research, innovation, partnerships, entrepreneurship, technology transfer and international development.

Learn more

Serving all learners at every stage of life

Assuming fundamental responsibility for the communities it serves, ASU's Learning Enterprise aims to serve learners at every stage of life by providing high-quality, accessible and affordable opportunities to everyone.

Learn more

Carve your path

At Arizona State University, you'll join a community that will help you explore your interests and learn new skills. Through quality academics, enrichment opportunities and support from friends and faculty, you'll graduate prepared to accomplish your goals throughout your life. Find the experience that fits you.

Reimagining education for everyone

New programs for all ages

Ambition, curiosity, creativity and passion don't fit in any one box. No matter who you are or how you learn, ASU is ready to serve learners at every stage of life. ASU for You is the first step in a larger movement — a movement that's breaking down education barriers and building up high quality, affordable and accessible learning opportunities for everyone, from K-12 to midcareer to postretirement and every individual in between.
